abstract: PROBLEM: The development of gestational trophoblastic tumors (GTT), in which genetic factors are strongly involved, is a rare event. To test the possibility that gene(s) linked to the Major histocompatibility Complex (MHC) may have a role in both embryo growth and tumor development, the HLA typing was performed on patients affected by GTT and on their partners. METHOD: The study group of sixteen couples, in which the women were affected by an invasive mole or choriocarcinoma, and the control group of thirty normal fertile couples without history of spontaneous abortion or GTT were typed for class I and class II HLA antigen. RESULTS: The results showed no differences in single HLA-A and B antigen frequency between GTT couples and controls. In HLA-DR, locus an increased frequency of DR-6 antigen was observed (p < 0.05). No differences were observed in the frequency of number of antigens shared. When considering the single locus no differences were found in the sharing of the antigens of the A and B locus, while the frequency of antigenic sharing for DR locus was significantly higher in GTT couples with respect to controls (p < 0.025). Furthermore a higher frequency of Bw35-DR5 antigenic combination was found in GTT partners than in controls (P < 0.02). CONCLUSIONS: These data represent a confirmation of the existence of a MHC linked gene(s) influencing the GTT development.
abstract_ja: 問題：遺伝的因子が強く関与する妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍(GTT)の発生はまれな事象です。胚の発育と腫瘍形成の両方に、MHC連鎖遺伝子が関与している可能性を検討するため、GTT患者とそのパートナーのHLA型を調べました。方法：侵入奇胎または絨毛癌の女性を有する16組の夫婦と、自然流産やGTTの既往がなく妊孕性が正常な対照30組について、クラスIおよびクラスIIのHLA抗原型を調べました。結果：GTT夫婦と対照の間で、HLA-AおよびB抗原の単一座の頻度に差はみられませんでした。HLA-DR座ではDR-6抗原の頻度増加が認められました(p<0.05)。抗原共有数の頻度に差はありませんでした。単一座で見ると、AおよびB座の抗原共有に差はありませんでしたが、DR座の抗原共有頻度はGTT夫婦で対照より有意に高値でした(p<0.025)。さらに、Bw35-DR5抗原の組み合わせはGTTのパートナーで対照より高頻度でした(P<0.02)。結論：これらのデータは、GTTの発症に影響するMHC連鎖遺伝子の存在を裏付けるものです。
